title: Score Studio prioritized implementation plan
author: Codex for Constantine
status: Repository planning reference; implementation and future acceptance pending

priorities.P0: Must complete the dependable card to actual local-game loop.
priorities.P1: Repeated balancing, supported mechanics, deeper card feel and reuse of existing visual tools.
priorities.P2: Expanded motion/sprite/external adapters and broader game systems after the common loop is proven.

milestones.title: Establish the running project and shared contracts
milestones.exit: Identify the actual served checkout, runtime and canonical data owners; preserve the current draft; validate a versioned change set without changing normal player state.

milestones.title: Complete one card to starter to actual game workflow
milestones.exit: Create and edit a supported custom card through Studio, install it in a starter, launch a fresh actual local run, play it and inspect its results. Export/import and Undo preserve the authored data.

milestones.title: Make repeated balancing work efficient and predictable
milestones.exit: Complete the three 15-card generation exercise with named recipes, sorting, selection, bulk changes and reversible cleanup; repeat after reload without rebuilding context.

milestones.title: Author supported mechanics and feature definitions
milestones.exit: Create a template bound to a supported engine effect, tune its scoring, archive/restore it and transfer it without losing IDs or references; actual-game behavior matches the declared binding.

milestones.title: Understand cards through controlled real-game experiments
milestones.exit: Card and Encounter Labs, event inspection and saved regression fixtures use the actual local runtime; legal costs, multi-turn utility, reactions and status lifecycles can be reproduced.

milestones.title: Connect the existing visual and feedback tools
milestones.exit: Native card layout, bounded production effects timing and supported HUD tokens can be edited, reviewed and seen in the actual local game without rebuilding separate editors.

milestones.title: Expand motion rules and sprite preparation
milestones.exit: Validated animation matching, frame/anchor preparation and the first selected external format round-trip correctly; runtime mechanics remain independent of presentation speed.

milestones.title: Extend proven authoring to other game systems
milestones.exit: Each added reward, enemy, progression or map editor has a verified runtime consumer, explicit application timing and a complete configure to actual-game acceptance path.

work_packages.title: Resolve the running project and effective configuration
work_packages.use_case: I want to know which project, rules and assets I am changing.
work_packages.ui_ux: Persistent project/profile and build/content/art revision indicator; show authored, resolved and loaded values plus field-specific application timing.
work_packages.implementation: Resolve the server working directory and exact runtime; inventory canonical owners, supported schemas, compiler paths, overrides and archived tools. Record a baseline and isolate test storage.
work_packages.interaction_target: One persistent project context; no repeated project picker for related edits.

work_packages.title: Introduce a versioned project and atomic change set
work_packages.use_case: I want to import and review a configuration without silently overwriting unrelated content.
work_packages.ui_ux: One review surface for scope, conflicts, dependencies and Merge/Replace section/Duplicate choices; validation errors retain the draft.
work_packages.implementation: Start with the minimal manifest for cards, weights, starters and test fixtures. Add schema/provider versions, stable references, source-revision guards and atomic commit/rollback. Expand the same manifest in later milestones.
work_packages.interaction_target: Conflict-free import: at most 3 Studio activations plus native file-picker actions; one review dialog.

work_packages.title: Create connected workspace and interaction foundations
work_packages.use_case: I want related tools to share my selected entity and working context.
work_packages.ui_ux: Six workspaces with shared library/preview/inspector, optional timeline, breadcrumbs, keyboard/focus/touch paths and Draft/Applied/Saved/Loaded status. Use concise labels, scope-aware tooltips and visible Cancel/Undo.
work_packages.implementation: Introduce shared view and operation-state models, not a wholesale restyle. Instrument task activations, menus, panel switches, scroll travel, waiting and cancellation. Capture current screenshots before changing visible flows.
work_packages.interaction_target: One contextual inspector for a routine edit; no stacked required modals; no hidden essential hover-only action.

work_packages.title: Expose clear card identity, costs and supported effects
work_packages.use_case: I want to change a card or compose a supported effect without raw-tag knowledge.
work_packages.ui_ux: Separate Camp, School, Tradition and Stance; inline costs and effects; duplicate from template; native preview and generated rules text beside authored fields. Preserve independent dimensions.
work_packages.implementation: Bind controls to the active profile schema and existing engine operations. Separate editable definitions from derived values. Reject unsupported bindings and invalid targets before Apply.
work_packages.interaction_target: Tradition-only change: at most 4 pointer activations from a visible card, one workspace, no modal; typed values counted separately.

work_packages.title: Deliver a reliable card collection and exact selection
work_packages.use_case: I want to find, sort and select the exact cards I intend to change.
work_packages.ui_ux: Gallery/table toggle; CP/name/ID/type sorts and directions; searchable deck filter; click/Ctrl/Shift/Ctrl+Shift/Ctrl+A/Escape; selected and hidden-selected counts; row opens its inspector.
work_packages.implementation: Key selection by stable IDs and define range anchors in current displayed order. Ctrl+A covers matching records, not rendered cells. Persist per-view sort/filter/order. Add other cost/rank/class sorts and grouping using the same model.
work_packages.interaction_target: Change sort in one activation when exposed; deck filter in at most 3; no selection loss on sort; native keyboard alternative for every selection action.

work_packages.title: Build decks and install arbitrary valid starters
work_packages.use_case: I want to add my card to a class starter and set copy counts.
work_packages.ui_ux: Two-pane library/deck builder, persistent starter entries, inline minus/quantity/plus, totals and restrictions; Add to starter beside selected card. Distinguish class eligibility, custom list and actual starter.
work_packages.implementation: Resolve card instances and starter references together; validate class/rules/copy counts and show before/after composition. Support requested Starseer starter through isolated test unlock, with Reaver fallback for the custom QA card.
work_packages.interaction_target: Add to a starter: at most 7 pointer activations for the stated class/quantity/replacement example; repeated same-class addition at most 4; one contextual setup dialog maximum.

work_packages.title: Launch the actual local game with the candidate revision
work_packages.use_case: I want to play the card I just authored in a fresh normal run.
work_packages.ui_ux: Test this draft and Start normal run show class, starter, overrides and loaded revision; progress/error states identify validation/build/load stages. Return to editor preserves context.
work_packages.implementation: Connect validated content to the actual game build/load pipeline; acknowledge effective runtime identity and starter. Pin a test snapshot; never substitute a parallel combat implementation. Keep visual reload and mechanical restart explicit.
work_packages.interaction_target: At most 3 Studio activations from a valid reviewed candidate to launch; ordinary gameplay and build wait measured separately.

work_packages.title: Add isolated class testing and one saved scenario
work_packages.use_case: I want to test a locked class and repeat a controlled encounter without altering progression.
work_packages.ui_ux: Explicit test profile, Practice versus labelled Training, class/deck/opponent/seed/resources summary and saved scenario picker. Start/Restart stay visible.
work_packages.implementation: Implement one supported scenario through the real runtime, with coherent state and legal costs by default. Isolate unlock overrides and save slots; record all training exceptions. Preserve profile and field lifetime contracts.
work_packages.interaction_target: Saved scenario selection and Start in at most 2 activations; Restart in 1; normal profile remains separate.

work_packages.title: Make edits recoverable and project handoff lossless
work_packages.use_case: I want to undo a whole experiment or restore its exact configuration.
work_packages.ui_ux: Undo/Redo named transactions, recoverable custom-definition Trash, clear export scopes and saved revision list. No implicit game write during pure export.
work_packages.implementation: Restore definitions, quantities, memberships and references atomically. Persist drafts; guard stale/cancelled jobs and partial writes. Round-trip the minimal full project and section files; add later schemas without losing fields.
work_packages.interaction_target: Undo or Redo in 1 activation/shortcut; conflict-free export in at most 2 Studio activations; no workspace switch required.

work_packages.title: Support multi-card drag and drop
work_packages.use_case: I want to drag a selection into a deck or remove it without losing definitions.
work_packages.ui_ux: Counted drag ghost; valid/invalid destination feedback; quantity preview; explicit Copy/Move; sidebar targets, hover-open, edge scroll, manual reorder and contextual remove/trash destinations.
work_packages.implementation: Reuse shared selection/deck transactions. Selected-card drag carries selection; unselected-card drag targets only that card. Escape cancels. Reorder explicitly changes sort to Manual. Trash is recoverable; deck removal preserves library definitions.
work_packages.interaction_target: One drag gesture after selection; gesture tracked separately from clicks. Equivalent menu path at most 3 activations.

work_packages.title: Expose contextual menus and bounded bulk changes
work_packages.use_case: I want the right actions for this card, deck, field or selection.
work_packages.ui_ux: Sticky selection bar and right-click/overflow/keyboard/touch menus; count-aware verbs; Mixed values; Set/Delta/percentage where supported; feature add/remove separate from replace-all. Hover and focus shortcuts for secondary actions.
work_packages.implementation: One command registry across toolbar/menu/shortcut paths. Preserve multiselection on selected-card right-click. Preview exact IDs and exclusions; apply only touched fields as one transaction.
work_packages.interaction_target: Context menu opens in 1 activation; routine available action requires at most 1 submenu; simple bulk field edit at most 7 activations plus entry.

work_packages.title: Persist independent tool and section presets
work_packages.use_case: I want to save defaults and return to tweak my last settings.
work_packages.ui_ux: Last used, Project default, named presets and factory baseline are distinct. Save as/Load/Set default/Reset default; section presets and dirty indicators; predictable Cancel semantics.
work_packages.implementation: Version per-tool and per-section settings independently for card/item generation, rebalance and naming. Persist compatible values across reopen/reload/restart; migrate older presets. Keep view context separate from operation scope.
work_packages.interaction_target: Recall a preset in at most 2 activations; repeated tweak does not reopen unrelated menus or lose scope.

work_packages.title: Unify generation and retain honest results
work_packages.use_case: I want three reproducible 15-card configurations directly in named decks.
work_packages.ui_ux: Simple/Distribution modes share destination, seed and preset controls. Show effective total, quotas, scoring profile, batch results, misses and Select/Keep/Reroll failed/Compare actions. Sticky footer and collapsible groups.
work_packages.implementation: Wrap existing pool and batch generators without silently changing their different rules. Keep recipe, weight revision, seed and output provenance. No silent exactness guarantee on misses; repeat-seed IDs must not overwrite unrelated records.
work_packages.interaction_target: Generate from a saved valid recipe into an existing deck in at most 4 activations; output batch selected automatically; native field edits counted separately.

work_packages.title: Make rebalancing scoped, repeatable and explainable
work_packages.use_case: I want to rebalance only these cards using remembered constraints.
work_packages.ui_ux: Explicit current/selection/filtered/deck/pool scope, affected count, lock-preserved fields, original/candidate comparison and Preview/Apply. Recipe transfer separate from output transfer.
work_packages.implementation: Keep current failure guard; stage candidate results and apply accepted IDs only. Preserve last valid constraints and advanced quotas per policy. Detect stale scope/results before commit and prevent silent all-card expansion.
work_packages.interaction_target: Existing selected scope: Preview and Apply in 2 activations after opening; another tweak requires no repeated scope reconstruction.

work_packages.title: Expose naming rules with real previews
work_packages.use_case: I want readable generated names and reusable naming conventions.
work_packages.ui_ux: Naming rules reachable from Auto-name/rename/generation; maximum length, priority, sample names, dropped components, collisions and impossible constraints. Distinguish rename once and keep updated.
work_packages.implementation: Use stable identity independently of names. Preserve manual names unless included; keep previous name set and atomic Undo. Validate mandatory components that cannot fit rather than silently breaking the limit.
work_packages.interaction_target: Naming rules open from a relevant tool in 1 activation; simple rule edit and Apply in at most 3 more activations plus entry.

work_packages.title: Compare and recall design variants
work_packages.use_case: I want to compare two batches or decks under the same test conditions.
work_packages.ui_ux: Named baseline/candidate, structural and effective-value differences, matched scenario and explicit changed recipe fields. Sequential trials are sufficient initially; avoid a second runtime implementation.
work_packages.implementation: Save immutable comparison inputs and actual revision identities. Replay controlled sequences with recorded seeds and training overrides. Explain legitimate RNG/event differences caused by changed mechanics.
work_packages.interaction_target: Run a saved comparison in at most 3 activations; retain scenario, pair and observations.

work_packages.title: Create a feature catalogue with reversible retirement
work_packages.use_case: I want obsolete features hidden from active authoring and restorable later.
work_packages.ui_ux: Search Active/Archived, add from catalogue, duplicate template, rename label, Find usages, archive and restore. Show dependent cards/rules/presets. Separate archive, disable scoring and retire gameplay.
work_packages.implementation: Stable IDs and compatibility-preserving references; archiving authoring availability alone does not erase an effect from existing cards or disable its score. Provide reviewed migration for actual retirement.
work_packages.interaction_target: Archive with reviewed impact in at most 4 activations; restore selected definition in 1; one impact dialog maximum.

work_packages.title: Author typed scoring templates
work_packages.use_case: I want flat, additive, per-unit or multiplicative weights with clear limits.
work_packages.ui_ux: Template selector, units, parameters, stacking/order/caps and supported conditions; worked score examples beside the active card. Explicitly distinguish scoring from gameplay behavior.
work_packages.implementation: Use a constrained expression/template schema with validation; no arbitrary code/method text. Preserve evaluation contracts and version formulas. Test zero, negative, fractional and capped inputs where allowed.
work_packages.interaction_target: Selected template parameter tweak and preview in at most 3 activations plus entry; no mandatory navigation to another tool.

work_packages.title: Compose mechanics using supported runtime bindings
work_packages.use_case: I want to design a mechanic and see its actual effect in the game.
work_packages.ui_ux: Trigger to Conditions to Targets to Effects to Duration/Stacking; supported bindings palette, costs/scaling/restrictions, ordered execution and generated text. Engine support required for unavailable behavior.
work_packages.implementation: Bind to the active runtime capability contract, not inferred method names. Validate targets, ranges, exclusions and recursive trigger paths. New engine operations are separately scoped engineering changes with headless contracts before exposure.
work_packages.interaction_target: Template parameter edit, Test and Apply in at most 5 coordination activations plus gameplay; basic effects remain accessible in card inspector.

work_packages.title: Transfer and migrate feature registries safely
work_packages.use_case: I want to import definitions without breaking cards or losing retired traits.
work_packages.ui_ux: Versioned import/export, conflicts, stable-ID references, missing bindings and reversible migration preview. Rename is not delete-and-recreate.
work_packages.implementation: Extend the project schema with definitions, scoring and runtime bindings as separate sections. Validate entire dependency graph before atomic commit; preserve archived records for compatible old content.
work_packages.interaction_target: Conflict-free known registry import in at most 5 Studio activations plus file picker; one review surface.

work_packages.title: Build Card and Encounter Labs around real decisions
work_packages.use_case: I want to feel a card under controlled resources, enemies and deck states.
work_packages.ui_ux: Saved scenario library; exact player/gear/stats, hand/piles, enemy state/intents and seed. Legal Practice default; visible Training exceptions. Maximize actual game and keep targets unobscured.
work_packages.implementation: Expand the one-scenario bridge to the twelve fixture families in this plan using the actual engine. Validate coherent state; isolate progression. Add checkpoint/replay only where engine support exists.
work_packages.interaction_target: Saved scenario select and Start in 2 activations, Restart in 1; advanced setup stays in one focused workspace.

work_packages.title: Explain events and step action separately from presentation
work_packages.use_case: I want to understand why a play succeeded and why a visual occurred.
work_packages.ui_ux: Optional event drawer with action/event IDs, costs, target/defense/status facts, cue rules and source links. Separate Step game action, Step presentation frame, Pause, speed and checkpoint replay.
work_packages.implementation: Instrument actual runtime facts without recalculating historical events from edited current rules. Preserve deterministic checkpoints/RNG; do not promise arbitrary backward game-state scrubbing. Correlate mechanics and presentation channels.
work_packages.interaction_target: Inspect the next event in 1 activation with drawer open; Pause/Step/Restart remain directly available.

work_packages.title: Save regression packs and measure usability and recovery
work_packages.use_case: I want repeatable proof and responsive tools at realistic collection sizes.
work_packages.ui_ux: Run saved pack, progress, cancel, failures with replay links and compact receipt. Record measured task costs and show recoverable unfinished work after interruption.
work_packages.implementation: Run UI-driven real-game fixtures plus focused engine/schema checks. Capture revisions, IDs, semantic receipts, screenshots and geometry evidence. Stress 1000-card and 10000-card fixtures; no per-card inspector loop for bulk operations.
work_packages.interaction_target: Saved pack select and Run in 2 activations; Cancel directly available; complete metrics for the ten reference tasks.

work_packages.title: Integrate native card appearance editing
work_packages.use_case: I want to design a card face and see that same rendering in hand.
work_packages.ui_ux: Layer/canvas selection, art crop, masks, typography, symbols, rank/cost/rules groups, snapping and anchors; explicit shared-template versus per-card scope. Hand/zoom/list/device samples and editable versus flattened export.
work_packages.implementation: Adapt existing native layout/component tools and renderer. Separate pure export from source save; validate source revision and preserve mechanic/text-token bindings. Do not introduce a divergent card renderer.
work_packages.interaction_target: Selected component tweak and native preview in at most 4 activations plus entry; common controls beside preview, advanced full editor linked.

work_packages.title: Connect production effect timing and approved feedback
work_packages.use_case: I want to tune impact, status, audio and card feedback without obscuring play.
work_packages.ui_ux: Compact timeline for approved clips, category timing/opacity, anchors and sample stress cases; real-card preview; clear loop/interruption/reset/reduced-motion controls. Distinguish sample receipts from combat facts.
work_packages.implementation: Reuse production effect planner/renderer/timing validation. Start with bounded existing settings and approved assets; add only supported audio/camera bindings. Engine owns mechanics; presentation speed cannot change state or RNG.
work_packages.interaction_target: Retained event/timing tweak and replay in at most 3 activations plus entry; full timeline optional.

work_packages.title: Author deterministic animation assignment rules
work_packages.use_case: I want tags and events to select predictable animations with visible fallbacks.
work_packages.ui_ux: Require-all/any/excluded tags, event phase, class/loadout/outcome, priority and fallback; Why this animation, matched examples, conflicts and dead-rule diagnostics. One actor action plus separate cue channels.
work_packages.implementation: Version matching policy; verify active first-match resolver and class-default weapon policy before adapting it. No silent art-policy changes. Do not duplicate a primary cast because several traits match. Supported event selectors only.
work_packages.interaction_target: Selected rule tweak and preview in at most 5 activations; rule explanation in 1 contextual action.

work_packages.title: Prepare sprites, anchors and coverage
work_packages.use_case: I want to import frames, align them and see which actions are missing.
work_packages.ui_ux: Import loose frames or a documented atlas subset; slice/trim/padding, duration/loop, onion skin, floor/hand/muzzle/hit anchors, world scale and class/action/gear matrix. Missing, unique and fallback states differ.
work_packages.implementation: Wrap normalization/export/import helpers in fresh staging with explicit transformations. Preserve logical bounds, source art/provenance and stable asset IDs. Keep editable masters separate from pinned immutable runtime cache.
work_packages.interaction_target: One import wizard with a preview; retained frame/anchor adjustment and replay in at most 3 activations plus entry.

work_packages.title: Expose supported game UI appearance and interaction previews
work_packages.use_case: I want to tune card/game readability and check it while playing.
work_packages.ui_ux: Permitted UI tokens, responsive views/states, readable tooltips and text backing; game preview of keyboard/touch/focus/targeting behaviour. Preserve the playfield and support reduced motion.
work_packages.implementation: Reuse Component Studio layer/transform controls and validated HUD token merge/compiler bridge. Its design pages are specimens, not a ready game-navigation editor; new navigation/data bindings need explicit runtime support.
work_packages.interaction_target: Retained supported token change, preview and Apply in at most 4 activations plus entry; no manual file merge in routine use.

work_packages.title: Add selected external format adapters only when justified
work_packages.use_case: I want specialist editors to hand assets into Studio without rebuilding them.
work_packages.ui_ux: Choose a format, preview supported metadata and losses, map IDs/anchors and validate before import. Deep-link external authoring where useful; no promise of arbitrary document compatibility.
work_packages.implementation: First evaluate Aseprite PNG+JSON. TexturePacker subset, baked Effekseer exports, Rive UI motion or a live effects runtime are separate optional adapters. Confirm source/runtime licences, packaging, reset, performance and accessibility before selecting one.
work_packages.interaction_target: Known format import uses one review wizard plus native file picker; no new runtime required for the first delivery.

work_packages.title: Author rewards, loot and economy
work_packages.use_case: I want to tune offers, eligibility, rarity and prices without finding source files.
work_packages.ui_ux: Typed reward/shop tables, eligibility and weights, cadence and price controls; explain effective overrides; preview and test the relevant normal-run stage.
work_packages.implementation: Expose only existing validated consumers, not unused card fields. Add per-subsystem presets and reference checks; preserve normal-run lifecycle and save compatibility.
work_packages.interaction_target: Selected one-field edit and review in at most 5 activations plus entry; one direct Test relevant scenario action.

work_packages.title: Author enemies, moves and encounters
work_packages.use_case: I want to tune a threat and play the exact encounter.
work_packages.ui_ux: Enemy stats/moves, repetition/weights, encounter composition and supported positions/intents; real threat receipts and Test encounter from selection.
work_packages.implementation: Resolve whether authored move/card data actually drives the active runtime. Show required opt-ins and effective projections; preserve AI/target/defense contracts and deterministic fixtures.
work_packages.interaction_target: Repeated enemy edit and test in at most 5 coordination activations plus gameplay; no silent edits to an unused source.

work_packages.title: Author progression and difficulty presets
work_packages.use_case: I want to tune unlocks and scaling with known application timing.
work_packages.ui_ux: Typed progression/unlock/difficulty controls, effective-value display and New run/Live/Device timing labels. Separate temporary test unlock from ordinary progress.
work_packages.implementation: Respect profile/fight snapshots and existing live framework tuning. Validate historical saves and resumed fights for changes whose contract permits live application.
work_packages.interaction_target: Recall/review/test a known valid preset in at most 3 activations plus gameplay.

work_packages.title: Author supported routes and supporting content
work_packages.use_case: I want to change map/run constraints, labels and supported asset assignments.
work_packages.ui_ux: Capability-aware route constraints, supporting definition editors and asset pickers; Find usages, missing-reference validation and actual-run route preview.
work_packages.implementation: Add one runtime-consumed subsystem at a time using shared manifest/presets/change sets. Arbitrary event scripting, new map algorithms and new engine semantics remain separately engineered scope.
work_packages.interaction_target: Selected preset modification and test in at most 5 coordination activations plus entry; retain seed and comparison baseline.

acceptance_tests.title: Prove source ownership, loaded revision and field timing
procedure: Identify the actual served checkout/runtime and export the current Studio draft through UI.
Choose one known supported profile value, one documented live framework value and one presentation/device value in isolated test data.
Review effective overrides and application timing, build/load through Studio, start a fresh run and exercise a supported resumed-fight case.
expected: Loaded content/runtime/art revisions match the reviewed candidate; stale builds fail visibly.
New-run pins, fight snapshots, permitted live tuning and presentation/device settings follow their actual contracts; no blanket fresh-run assumption.
evidence: Before/after UI exports, source-owner map, loaded-revision screenshot and actual runtime receipts.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Change only the intended identity dimension
procedure: Select a spell and record authored effects, costs, school, camp, tradition and stance.
Change Tradition to Divine and back to Arcane; separately edit School and Camp using their own controls.
Assign Attack stance while retaining spell source and Magic only, then launch the controlled actual-game fixture.
expected: Only the explicitly edited authored fields change. Derived scaling consequences are explained rather than mistaken for authored effect edits.
No school:divine substitution for tradition; no Martial tag accidentally introduced; game identity and action behaviour match the controls.
evidence: Authored-field diff, inspector screenshots, loaded card and actual play receipt.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Build the exact requested ten-card Starseer starter
procedure: Restore the supplied 20261125 Starseer fixture and import through UI with reviewed merge policy.
Choose Starseer starter: Arcane Strike 4, Mana Rite 1, Ward 4, Arcane Bolt 1; resolve names to stable IDs and verify total 10.
If Starseer is locked, use isolated test-class availability; keep normal progression unchanged. Start a fresh actual local game and inspect its full deck.
expected: Exact IDs and quantities reach the actual game. Studio list membership is not accepted as proof of installation.
Original fixture definitions remain preserved. Reaver fallback is valid for the Reaver QA card; class restrictions are not silently bypassed or original cards reclassified.
Fixture-dependent portion remains Blocked until the missing supplied JSON is recovered; no invented replacement is called equivalent.
evidence: Fixture hash/source, before/after starter export, normal-profile unlock state and actual full deck screenshot.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Create and actually play the supported custom card
procedure: Create a clearly named QA spell through UI, with Arcane tradition, Attack stance, Magic only and a supported two-hit damage effect.
Install it in the appropriate starter; use a Reaver-specific duplicate/fallback if needed, without mutating original definitions.
Launch a fresh normal run on the actual local game and play the card against a legal target.
expected: Card appears in the intended starter and hand; costs are paid exactly once.

Two supported resolved-hit events occur, with defense/scaling explained and no duplicate primary action. If two-hit binding is unsupported, it is explicitly blocked until engineered; the basic supported card still must play.
evidence: UI steps, authored export, loaded revision, deck/hand screenshots and actual cost/hit/cue receipts.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Bulk-remove only the 45 generated cards
procedure: Back up baseline definitions through UI and generate three identifiable 15-card batches.
Filter/select all 45 by batch identity; inspect selected/hidden counts and remove only these added definitions in one transaction.
Check original definitions and deck references; Undo, Redo and inspect the actual game under the restored or remaining chosen test configuration.
expected: No original definition or unrelated membership changes. One Undo restores all 45 definitions and relationships.
Trash and deck removal have distinct meanings. Empty deck-container cleanup is optional and explicit.
evidence: Before/after ID and definition comparison, selected-count confirmation, Undo/Redo export and game deck check.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Preserve exact selection through sort, context actions and drag
procedure: Click an anchor, Shift-select a range, Ctrl-deselect two cards and Ctrl+Shift-add another range.
Sort by CP/name/ID/type; filter some selected cards out and inspect hidden-selected count.
Right-click a selected card, drag the group into a valid starter/deck, adjust copies, then Undo. Repeat using keyboard/menu alternatives.
Launch that candidate starter in the actual game.
expected: The same stable IDs stay selected after sort; next range uses current displayed order.
Only previewed IDs/copies are transferred; one Undo restores source/destination/quantity/order. Ctrl+A covers matching records beyond virtualized viewport.
Manual reorder explicitly selects Manual sorting; invalid drops explain restrictions and mutate nothing.
evidence: Selected-ID exports at checkpoints, action/menu/drag log, starter diff and actual full deck screenshot.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Verify independent defaults and last-used state
procedure: Save different whole-tool and section presets for Pool generation, Batch Cards, Batch Items, Rebalance and Naming.
Set a project default, tweak last-used values, Cancel as specified, reopen, reload browser and restart local server/application.
Load/export/import presets and repeat generation/rebalance into an isolated game fixture.
expected: Each tool/section retains the declared values without cross-contaminating Card/Item counts. Named preset, default, factory and last-used states remain distinct.
Cancel follows one documented contract; scopes never silently expand. Actual game output identifies the recipe/weight revision.
evidence: State matrix with expected/actual values at reopen/reload/restart, preset exports and actual output receipt.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Generate three reproducible fifteen-card configurations honestly
procedure: Use three named rank-distribution recipes with separate seeds to make three 15-card decks under a recorded scoring profile.
Separately exercise three distinct scoring-profile variants if supported, clearly separating changed weights from changed generation quotas.
Check school/camp/rank/cost quotas, exact-CP flags, IDs and destination; retry only misses; repeat a recipe/seed.
Install an accepted generated test card/deck and play it in the actual local game.
expected: Each accepted batch has 15 entries and its recorded recipe. Exact mode meets targets; any best-effort mode explicitly lists misses before acceptance.
Repeated seeds reproduce content decisions without overwriting unrelated IDs; no false claim that three rank distributions are three weight models.
Displayed costs/effects agree with actual runtime resolution, subject to visible scaling/defense.
evidence: Recipes, weight revisions, output exports, miss report, deterministic comparison and actual game play receipt.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Rebalance the intended scope and keep constraints
procedure: Select/filter one QA card while other definitions remain in the pool. Open Rebalance and inspect scope.
Change advanced rank quotas and constraints; reopen/reload as specified. Preview an infeasible target and then a feasible supported case.
Apply only the intended result, launch the candidate in the actual game, and Undo.
expected: Scope and counts match intent, remembered settings follow AT07, and other cards are untouched.
Infeasible results cannot silently commit; recipe export contains settings rather than just cards. Actual loaded card reflects the accepted result.
evidence: Scope/constraint snapshots, recipe and definition diffs, failed-preview explanation, actual play and Undo export.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Rename without silent loss or identity changes
procedure: Set a short name limit, reorder component priorities and test long/mandatory-component examples.
Preview rename-once and Auto-name on a selected batch, preserving manual names unless included.
Save preset, reload, apply, Undo and start the actual game with a renamed card.
expected: Length/collisions/dropped parts are explicit; impossible mandatory-name combinations require a decision instead of silent truncation.
Stable IDs, starter references and effects stay intact; game name/text and actual card identity match.
evidence: Naming preset, before/after names/IDs, collision/limit preview and actual hand/inspection screenshot.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Archive, restore and migrate a referenced feature
procedure: Create or select a supported referenced feature; inspect its usages.
Archive authoring availability, restore it, rename its display label, then test separately disabling its scoring contribution.
Review a true gameplay retirement/migration as a distinct operation and import/export the registry. Play a referencing card before/after the permitted operations.
expected: Archive hides active authoring choices but preserves historical references and stable ID; restore recovers it.
Changing a label or scoring weight does not silently remove gameplay. Actual retirement has an explicit dependency/migration result.
evidence: Registry/ref graph diffs, active/archived views, score breakdown and actual gameplay receipts.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Validate formula structure and scoring/gameplay separation
procedure: Create supported flat, additive, per-unit and multiplier templates with units, caps and ordering.
Exercise zero, fractional, negative and boundary values where allowed; reject invalid units/ranges/conditions.
Tune only scoring, then separately tune an actual effect through supported controls and play both candidates.
expected: Worked score matches the declared formula and evaluation order.
A scoring-only edit changes evaluation, not mechanics; a mechanic edit changes actual runtime receipts as declared.
evidence: Template JSON, worked calculations, validation output and paired actual-game receipts.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Compose supported trigger mechanics and reject unsupported behavior
procedure: Build a supported trigger/condition/target/effect/duration template and preview execution order.
Exercise valid, invalid-target and recursion/counter-chain cases through the actual engine.
Attempt to choose an unavailable runtime effect or arbitrary method name.
expected: Only supported bindings can be accepted; undefined behavior displays Engine support required.
Runtime executes the configured sequence with applicable guardrails and no infinite/duplicate trigger path.
evidence: Capability/binding versions, validation, action/event trace and error-state screenshots.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Round-trip project sections and reject bad imports atomically
procedure: Export full project and individual cards/weights/presets/registry/layout/scenario sections as implemented.
Import into a clean isolated project; test duplicate IDs, old schema, missing references/assets/bindings and a stale source revision.
Cancel a reviewed conflict and then import a valid resolution; start the same actual-game fixture.
expected: Supported fields and relationships survive semantically losslessly; expected metadata changes are identified.
Rejected/cancelled imports write no partial state; original project survives. Runtime loads the imported candidate and reproduces supported behavior.
evidence: Normalized semantic diff, conflict/validation results, source revision guards and actual loaded-revision receipt.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Use the same card design in editor and actual hand
procedure: Edit a shared template and a separate per-card appearance override using native controls.
Preview short/long/localized text, high costs/ranks and dense effects at hand/zoom/list/device sizes.
Apply design and play/inspect those cards in the actual game; pure Export must not save source.
expected: Native rendering and text/mechanic tokens agree; shared scope versus override is explicit.
No unintended clipping/overlap or broken anchors; readable controls remain reachable. Exported editable and flattened artifacts are clearly different.
evidence: Layout scope diff, native preview and actual game screenshots, overflow/geometry checks and export/source comparison.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Resolve one intended actor action and layered cues
procedure: Create rules for a Magic-only Arcane spell with Attack stance, a counter preparation/return and a status apply/update/remove lifecycle.
Add competing/equal-priority rules, missing clips and intentional class fallbacks; inspect Why this animation.
Play each case in the actual game with the reviewed class/loadout policy.
expected: Exactly one winning actor action per channel; additional traits do not duplicate the primary cast.
Conflicts/missing bindings are diagnosed; phase and fallback are correct. Class-default weapon/art policy is not silently replaced.
evidence: Effective tags, winning-rule trace, action/cue IDs, coverage status and actual game capture.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Keep mechanics deterministic across presentation changes
procedure: Replay one fixed legal scenario at normal, slow and fast presentation, reduced motion and skip settings.
Exercise interruption, target defeat, scene exit, repeated actions and status-cue cleanup.
Step actual actions and presentation frames separately.
expected: Domain state, paid costs, RNG position and semantic mechanical event order match across presentation-only variants; timestamps/frame counts may differ.
No ghost particles/audio/camera offsets, duplicate damage, skipped statuses or stuck inputs remain after cleanup.
evidence: Semantic receipt/state comparison, cue lifecycle/resource counts and actual captures.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Import sprite metadata and align it in the real scene
procedure: Import loose frames or the first supported PNG+JSON atlas fixture with trim/padding and per-frame durations.
Set logical bounds, pivots and floor/hand/muzzle/hit anchors; inspect loops and coverage.
Replace an asset by stable ID and play matching actions across supported class/equipment contexts.
expected: Frame order/duration, logical bounds and anchors survive roundtrip. Intended floor/scale alignment is stable within the declared fixture tolerance.
Missing and fallback actions are labelled honestly; no accidental other-class art substitution or immutable cache mutation.
evidence: Imported metadata/asset hashes, anchor overlay, coverage matrix and actual game motion capture.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Exercise the Card and Encounter Lab fixture families
procedure: Create/save one fixture in each of the twelve families listed in the plan, using supported state controls.
Test exactly-affordable and unaffordable plays under Practice, then explicit Training.
Play multiple turns and inspect targets, defenses, reactions, status lifecycles, piles and normal-run transition cases.
expected: Actual local engine and renderer execute all accepted setups; coherent state and training exceptions are visible.
Legal refusal/affordability and multi-turn tradeoffs are observable; isolated tests do not alter ordinary progression/saves.
evidence: Scenario manifest, loaded revisions, input/action log, runtime events, observations and normal-profile state check.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Compare and replay actual game revisions
procedure: Choose saved baseline/candidate and identical scenario/seed, then run a recorded legal action sequence.
Reset/replay from a supported checkpoint and compare outcomes plus resource/pacing observations.
Change a mechanic and a presentation setting in separate comparisons.
expected: Same candidate/fixture reproduces semantic results; changed mechanics can legitimately change outcomes/RNG usage and the comparison explains it.
No arbitrary rewind promise; presentation-only changes satisfy AT17. Baseline and candidate identity remain distinct.
evidence: Both content revisions, fixture/actions, effective values, outcome/decision notes and replay receipts.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Tune supported HUD/feedback and preserve playability
procedure: Edit permitted token/layout/feedback values and preview narrow, desktop and wide forms with long text.
Use keyboard, pointer and touch-equivalent controls, reduced motion and open/close inspector modes.
Play a targeted card while checking tooltips, overlays, selection and input routing.
expected: Supported edits reach actual game through validated owners; arbitrary specimen layout is not falsely presented as live gameplay navigation.
Targets, costs and outcomes remain readable/reachable; menus do not accidentally trigger game input; reduced-motion alternative remains informative.
evidence: Token/source diff, viewport/input records, actual game screenshots and focus/target geometry checks.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Cancel jobs and recover interruptions without partial commits
procedure: Start a large generation/rebalance/import operation; cancel before commit.
Start a newer job or edit its source while an older preview is running; close/reload during a staged operation.
Recover draft and launch its last valid actual-game configuration.
expected: Cancelled/stale results cannot overwrite newer content or broaden scope.
Draft/source is intact, progress/error state explains recovery, and actual game loads a valid acknowledged revision.
evidence: Job IDs/state, cancellation/recovery UI, source/draft diff and actual loaded-revision receipt.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Undo, redo and restart with complete relationships
procedure: Exercise definition edits, deck quantities, bulk removal, naming, generation, layout and imports as supported.
Undo/Redo each transaction, export semantic state and reopen/reload/restart.
Launch a restored starter and play its restored card.
expected: All affected definitions, IDs, names, memberships, quantities and presets restore together.
No original content loss or hidden pending source write; actual game matches the chosen restored revision.
evidence: Before/Undo/Redo semantic exports, persistence matrix and actual starter/play receipt.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Prove every broader editor reaches its actual runtime consumer
procedure: For each implemented rewards/shop/enemy/encounter/progression/difficulty/map section, change one owned value through UI.
Review profile/override/opt-in/application timing, validate/build and navigate to the relevant actual normal-run or encounter stage.
Exercise supported save/resume compatibility and restore baseline.
expected: Actual offer/price/move/route/progression behavior reflects the effective candidate value, not an unused authored field.
Unsupported fields stay unavailable; appropriate new-run/live/presentation timing and ordinary profile isolation are preserved.
evidence: Owner/effective-value receipt, authored diff, actual stage capture and restore/resume evidence.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Keep selection and common work responsive at scale
procedure: Load isolated 1000-card reference and 10000-card stress fixtures through UI.
Search, sort, Ctrl+A, inspect hidden selection, bulk edit, drag and cancel a long job.
Install a small valid result into a starter and play it.
expected: Virtualization does not change semantic selection or scope. No mandatory per-card editing loop; progress and cancellation remain reachable.
Measure agreed reference-hardware latency/memory/scroll targets established in M0, rather than inventing a performance pass from screenshots.
evidence: Hardware/build/viewport, measured responsiveness and memory, selected IDs, job metrics and actual game result.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Validate one external format or supporting asset adapter end to end
procedure: Select a documented source-format subset and retain original file/provenance metadata.
Import to fresh staging, review unsupported metadata/coordinate conversions and export the accepted subset.
Assign the resulting asset/content reference, rebuild/load and exercise it in the actual game.
expected: No claim of arbitrary compatibility; metadata/trim/pivots/durations and source references satisfy the chosen contract.
No proprietary editor copying or implicit publication; malformed/unsupported data cannot partially replace approved runtime assets.
evidence: Source/adapter versions, licence/provenance decision, roundtrip comparison and actual scene capture.
acceptance_tests.status: Planned; not run by this implementation-plan task

acceptance_tests.title: Measure the ten reference workflows and contextual quality
procedure: Run all ten reference tasks in the plan from their stated starting conditions with pointer and keyboard routes, then narrow/touch equivalents where supported.
Record actual activations, field edits, menus, interfaces, workspace switches, maximum modal depth, scroll travel, waits, errors, re-entry and displaced actions.
Complete the runtime portions in the actual local game and compare with proposed interaction budgets.
expected: Observed counts replace planning estimates; missed budgets and unintuitive/mislabelled/dead actions are documented.
No nested required modals, no essential hover-only controls, and no context reconstruction for a simple repeated tweak.
evidence: Task-by-task I want to records, counts, viewport/input conditions, screenshots and actual-game receipts.

reuse_inventory.name: Current Score Studio selection, deck, generation, naming, rebalance and weight components

reuse_inventory.subset: Existing production effect model/planner/renderer, timing validation and actual-art stage; use as the bounded motion control surface.
reuse_inventory.limit: Synthetic preview events are not evidence of actual combat. Normal-run and real-event linking remain mandatory.

reuse_inventory.name: Shared card animation family and current mapping policy
reuse_inventory.subset: Use live/Reading Desk family, timing, supported action resolution and honest per-class fallbacks.
reuse_inventory.limit: Documents may describe different revisions. Verify active resolver and class-default weapon policy; no automatic sprite swap from a balance edit.

reuse_inventory.name: Sprite normalization, import/export and art manifests
reuse_inventory.subset: Frame/bounds/scale staging, stable asset references, source provenance and runtime export paths.
reuse_inventory.limit: CLI helpers require a validated UI wrapper; some art sources are in AI-Art. Do not edit pinned runtime cache or claim missing animations exist.

reuse_inventory.name: HUD Component Studio and permitted token bridge
reuse_inventory.subset: Layers, snapping/group transforms, hide/lock, form factors, Undo and editable JSON; connect supported token export/merge/compiler.
reuse_inventory.limit: Design scenes are specimens, not working game navigation; only permitted bindings are initially in scope.

reuse_inventory.name: Canonical schemas, content/config/framework compilers and atomic write helpers
reuse_inventory.subset: Resolve ownership, validate, build isolated test revision and report effective field lifetime; reuse build-lock and save bridges.

reuse_inventory.name: Existing real-game QA, screenshot and acceptance infrastructure

reuse_inventory.name: Optional external adapters and transferable editor patterns
reuse_inventory.subset: Aseprite PNG+JSON first; consider bounded TexturePacker, baked Effekseer, Rive UI or Fabric components only after a concrete unmet need.

scenario_families.name: Baseline target
scenario_families.setup: Known class/gear and ordinary single target
scenario_families.inspect: Costs, targeting clarity and ordinary effect pacing.

scenario_families.name: Groups and area
scenario_families.setup: Multiple legal targets, supported positions, multihit/AoE
scenario_families.inspect: Per-hit/per-target order, readable overlaps, one primary actor action.

scenario_families.name: Defenses
scenario_families.inspect: Defense ordering, actual damage receipt, correct blocked/avoided feedback.

scenario_families.name: Resource pressure
scenario_families.inspect: Paid cost/refusal, opportunity cost and alternatives under legal Practice.

scenario_families.name: Low health and outcomes
scenario_families.setup: Near defeat, on-kill/overkill and target loss
scenario_families.inspect: Correct outcome, cancellation/cleanup, transition or reward.

scenario_families.name: Reactions
scenario_families.setup: Counter preparation/return, block and evade conditions
scenario_families.inspect: Held states, actual trigger ownership and no duplicate return.

scenario_families.name: Status lifecycle
scenario_families.setup: Apply, stack, refresh, expire and cleanse
scenario_families.inspect: Rules/text/timing agreement and separate cue phases.

scenario_families.name: Card piles
scenario_families.inspect: Instance identity, pile transitions and readable hand behavior.

scenario_families.name: Cycling and synergy
scenario_families.setup: Multi-turn deck cycle and supported trigger chains
scenario_families.inspect: Utility beyond one hit, resource tradeoffs and recursive guards.

scenario_families.name: Class and equipment
scenario_families.inspect: Legality, actual family policy and explicit intentional fallback.

scenario_families.name: Presentation stress
scenario_families.setup: Overlapping effects, missing/cold assets, reduced motion, narrow view
scenario_families.inspect: Input responsiveness, outcome readability and cleanup.

scenario_families.name: Normal-run transitions
scenario_families.inspect: Runtime consumption beyond a controlled single fight.

Remove from this deck preserves definitions.

Drag reorder explicitly switches to Manual ordering.

Scope-aware verbs such as Remove 15 cards from this deck.
Right-click, overflow, keyboard and touch parity.

Replace a card while retaining quantity.
Find usages before shared definition edits.

Live examples including dropped name parts.

Stable IDs with editable display labels.
